ratings_why.fun: Clear growth curve from Strays and Groomer to Cheese-Rind, Bell-Ringer and Speaker, with four late endings to choose between; the first two tiers are a little quiet.
ratings_why.distinct: Over a 7 because split damage is the default for every Rat: it rewrites how Shield, Damage Reduction and every 'takes damage' trigger work, and no tribe today moves damage between units.

verdict_why: v3 cleared the readability gaps; what remains is heat for the owner to balance, and more passes would make it different, not better.

points.text: Tiers 1-2 pay off little from splitting, since early knots are two or three units. A Tier 1 or 2 rat that gains when its knot wastes a share would show the identity in the first fights.
Little Fips's empty-slot doubling pulls against the full-board knot the tribe wants. Keying it to being at the end of the knot's chain would keep the Outermost flavour and stay useful late.
Loyal Cagemate is thin for Tier 3. Its Strays could come back Tied to the units next to it with a small buff, so it repairs the knot as well as holding Quorum.

standouts.why: The Thirty-Two turns the whole board into one body; a capstone the comp is built to reach.
The Piper flips the tribe's fear into a real late choice: grow tied, fight untied, with a reading-order puzzle.
Bell-Ringer's vote self-balances the knot's stats, a buffer with a decision in it.

weakest.why: Little Fips is a plain early body whose bonus fights the tribe's own goal.
Loyal Cagemate's two 1/1 Strays are low output for Tier 3.
Knot of Ill Omen is situational and can spread your own small hits.

flags.note: Shared pool with Old Gundel, or Damage Reduction copied per share by Supper Sniffer, could make small hits do nothing while Attack climbs.
Golden Ilse gives each Gossip unit the knot's whole gain; with Speaker at Quorum 7 that is +18/+18 a turn per Gossip unit, more with a tied Ooze.
Speaker at Quorum 7 adds 42 stats a turn and feeds every Gossip unit on top.
Golden King copies the knot twice; with the Piper's free swing it may end fights before they start.
